description:
About Wunderkind:

Wunderkind is a performance marketing solution that uses AI and data to help brands acquire and retain customers through one-to-one, personalized messages across websites, email, text, and ads, guaranteeing a lift in revenue. Founded in 2010, Our goal is to scale a brand’s ability to create and grow customer relationships through websites, email, text, and ads. We believe individuals should have the freedom to choose the kind of internet they want. An internet that fosters genuine relationships with brands. An internet that treats humans like real people instead of “web traffic.” We also believe in empowering brands to treat their customers as individuals, satisfying their unique needs with tailored experiences and thoughtful communication. By expertly personalizing, automating, and scaling beautiful one-to-one experiences, Wunderkind helps brands acquire new customers at scale and keep them loyal for life.

About the Role:

We’re hiring an ESP Partnerships Manager to sit on our Partnerships team and drive incremental revenue through our two of our strategic ESP partnerships: Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Braze. You’ll own both relationships end to end, from enabling their field teams to delivering sourced and influenced closed-won revenue. This is a commercially-oriented role focused on revenue and new deal flow, not just leads or partner sign-ups.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Salesforce & Braze sales and CS enablement
    • Build and run enablement programs for Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Braze AEs, CSMs, solution consultants, and partner teams (training, collateral, playbooks, office hours).
    • Make it easy for Salesforce and Braze reps to identify where Wunderkind complements their platform, when to pull us in, and how we help them close/retain business.
  • Revenue generation from Salesforce and Braze
    • Source and progress new revenue opportunities from Salesforce and Braze field teams into the Wunderkind pipeline.
    • Build joint plays with each partner (vertical, use case, segment, shared customer base) that convert into co-sell opportunities and sourced deals.
    • Track and report against opportunity volume, pipeline value, and closed-won revenue attributed to Salesforce and Braze.
  • Market mapping & TAM 
    • Partner with the sales team to map TAM across the Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Braze customer bases and their agency and SI ecosystems, build named account lists, and define coverage models.
    • Create partner-specific prospecting packages (talk tracks, proof points, case studies) that sales reps can run at scale.
    • Represent the Partnerships team at Salesforce and Braze events (e.g., Connections, Dreamforce, Braze Forge) to identify opportunities for lead generation and deal acceleration
  • Internal coordination & reporting
    • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, RevOps and Product to keep our Salesforce and Braze go-to-market motions, integrations, and messaging aligned.
    • Maintain a clean view of partner-influenced pipeline, forecast, and performance; communicate wins, gaps, and next moves.

What success looks like:

  • Salesforce and Braze programs are directly tied to revenue: measurable sourced and influenced ARR, not just activity and leads.
  • Salesforce and Braze reps see Wunderkind as a default partner for ID reach and Signals in downmarket and mid-market accounts.
  • Clear visibility into TAM, active plays, and performance across both partnerships.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or agency development in martech/adtech, ESP, or SaaS.
  • Proven track record of hitting or exceeding revenue targets tied to partners and agencies.
  • Required: hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze, whether at the ESP itself, at a partner or agency in its ecosystem, or as a power user at a brand. You understand how their field teams sell and how their partner programs run. Experience with both is a strong plus.
  • Strong commercial instincts: you think in terms of pipeline, coverage, conversion, and deal strategy, not just relationship-building.
  • Comfortable working with sales teams and BDRs; you know how to build programs that reps actually use.
  • Excellent communicator and operator – able to run enablement, manage a book of partners, and report clearly on outcomes.

The base salary range for this role is $85,000.00 to $100,000.00. The compensation package includes variable earnings. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. Our pay bands include different levels for different USA states, so salaries may vary depending on living location and market rate.
